headlines.title: Mid-market firms’ optimism grows despite economic uncertainty
headlines.summary: Encouraged by stronger financial performance, companies are planning to ramp up investments — particularly in AI, a Capital One executive said.

headlines.title: U.S. Credit Card Delinquencies Rise in October Amid Resilient Spending
headlines.summary: October card delinquencies and charge-offs rose across JPM, C, BAC and COF, but solid spending and below-year-ago credit losses signal consumer resilience.

headlines.title: What Capital One Financial Holders Got Wrong Before The Slide
headlines.summary: If you felt whiplash watching Capital One Financial headline upbeat Discover integration milestones alongside fresh legal and regulatory questions, you were not alone. Investors who held Capital One Financial from the start of the year are down 23.5%, including dividends.

headlines.title: Bank Stocks Slip After Outages Disrupt US Customers
headlines.summary: JPMorgan said there was no evidence the disruption was cyber-related

headlines.title: Customer Satisfaction with Bank and Credit Card Account Protection Declines as Fraud Proliferates
headlines.summary: TROY, Mich., November 17, 2026--JD Power: 52% of bank and 58% of credit card customers say their providers have not proactively prompted them to review their security settings.

description: Capital One Financial Corporation operates as the financial services holding company for the Capital One, National Association, which engages in the provision of various financial products and services in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. It operates through three segments: Credit Card, Consumer Banking, and Commercial Banking. The company accepts checking accounts, money market deposits, negotiable order of withdrawals, savings deposits, time deposits, and sweep accounts. Its loan products include credit card and personal loans; auto and retail banking loans; and commercial and multifamily real estate, and commercial and industrial loans. The company offers credit and debit card products; bank lending; and provides advisory, capital markets, net interchange, treasury management, and depository services. It serves consumers, small businesses, and commercial clients through digital channels, branches, cafés, and other distribution channels located in New York, Louisiana, Texas, Maryland, Virginia, New Jersey, and the District of Columbia. Capital One Financial Corporation was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in McLean, Virginia.
